title: Megurine Luka — Wiping Away Twilight Rain〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay. That sounded pretty good!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Practicing hard, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, Ichika and the girls are getting so much better these days, so I have to keep up.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay. How long will you practice for?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I just finished my section practice, so I'm done for today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well then, I should show you what you missed the other day.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What did I miss?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Something our dear juniors shared with us.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Here. Photos of the play-planetarium session that Saki brought the other day when she came over.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, show me show me!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ah, this was taken when we were toasting with our drinks. This was when Honami was doing narration.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And this one... Oh!
They were playing rock-paper-scissors to see who would get the remaining snacks.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone looks so happy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. There's even a picture of sleepy-looking Saki.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm really so glad Saki is back on her feet again.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So am I, and I'm sure Ichika, Shiho, and Honami are as well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They've always wanted to be of some help to her, after all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. Saki's always smiling even when overexerting herself.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Indeed...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She would be by herself in a hospital room far away, when everyone was spending time together in school.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It must have been lonely.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That was probably why she was rushing to make up for all that lost time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. But it feels like she had gotten over all that during the play-planetarium, all thanks to you, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I just gave her a listening ear, that's all.
I'm glad to know that turned out to be somewhat helpful.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Come to think about it, Ichika and the girls were making plans to go to a few other fun places together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Like different shops and events.
Everyone was doing their part and trying to research different places.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's really nice.
Making plans together can be a very fun activity in itself.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's how they intend to keep on making fond memories together, huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to see what sort of memories they'll be making.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yup. They've only just formed the band too.
I'm sure they'll keep getting better.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is only just the beginning for them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope I can keep watching over them as they grow.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me too. They may lose their way or face obstacles again, like they did this time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There may even be things they'll hold back from saying to each other because of being childhood friends.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When that happens, we'll be there to lend them a helping hand. There must be something we can do for them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're going all in, aren't you, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anything for my dearest junior classmen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want to be a supportive senior classman like you, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure you do.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I personally think you're already one, though?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, really!
